name: Eggless Butterscotch Cake
steps: Heat oven to 170°C and line a 15 cm tin. Sift flour, baking powder and baking soda; whisk sponge sugar, yogurt, milk, oil and vanilla separately.
Fold dry ingredients into wet, pour into the tin and bake 30–35 minutes until a skewer is clean. Cool fully and cut into two layers.
Melt caramel sugar in a heavy pan over medium heat until amber. Take off heat, carefully stir in butter and warm sauce cream, then salt; cool. Chop toasted cashews.
Whip cold cream with icing sugar to firm peaks. Spread cream, a little sauce and cashews between sponge layers; coat the cake, drizzle with remaining sauce and scatter the remaining nuts.
Refrigerate the decorated cake for 30 minutes so the layers set before slicing.
tips: Warm cream before adding it to caramel; cold cream makes the hot sugar seize and splatter.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
